notes.title: Moe Jigsaw - Patch v1.11
notes.notes:
Patch Notes v1.11:

    1 new jigsaw puzzle were added.
    This game is compatible with ≪Steam Cloud≫.
    This game is compatible with ≪Steam Trading Cards≫.
    The size of Puzzle Board is extended.
    Puzzle Board has become possible to move by sliding in any direction.
    Puzzle Board has become possible to scale up and down.
    Radar is added to show the size of Puzzle Board and current display position.
    A tutorial about Puzzle Board is added.
    Auto Save function has been improved while playing.
    ON/OFF operation of Preview has become possible by pushing [P] of your keyboard. Key customize is possible from Input tab in option setting at start up time.
    We have fixed some problems so that you can play game more comfortably.

notes.title: Moe Jigsaw – Patch v1.10
notes.notes:
Patch Notes v1.10:

    2 new jigsaw puzzles were added.
    You can now right click to rotate a puzzle piece while dragging it to move.
    You can now rotate a puzzle piece with [/D] on keyboard. Key customize is possible from Input tab in option setting at start up time.
    Close button was added to Gallery mode.
    A message icon added on an original illustration displayed by clicking [Preview] to show that scaling image is possible by scrolling mouse wheel.
    We have fixed some problems so that you can play game more comfortably.

notes.title: Release a "Puzzle Pack DLC"
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing!

We will commence sales of "Puzzle Pack DLC" now. When you want to play more "Moe & Kawaii" jigsaw puzzles, please purchase "Puzzle Pack DLC".


The original illustration displayed by clicking the "preview" can be zoom in or out by scrolling with the mouse wheel.
